answer: Sybil resistance here comes from making identity costly to rent, not just to buy. Imagine an inlet where every account must funnel its claims through a pulse of periodic stake checkpoints: each epoch you lock collateral, answer, and only graded survivors release it. An ocean of fake accounts drowns because every drop pays the same lock fee while grading is scarce — the jury samples K attestors, wrong answers burn stake, and reputation decays without fresh honest epochs, so hoarded bot farms bleed value faster than one-shot payouts can refill them.
